vumanchu_gold.plot_offset_note: TradingView plots the dot on pivot_bar with offset=-2; alert is emitted only on detection_bar after two later bars have closed.
vumanchu_gold.rolling_1_calendar_month_note: EXHAUSTIVE and UNTRUNCATED across every current S&P500 constituent successfully evaluated by VuManChu. COMPLETE requires 100% current-universe VuManChu coverage with zero failures/missing assets.
vumanchu_gold.parity_diagnostic_note: Every Gold event exports exact Pine gate inputs, current/reference fractal windows, detection_bar_high, and 1D lifecycle so TradingView mismatches such as ODFL can be isolated without changing the RAW formula.
vumanchu_gold.validation_samples_note: Backward-compatible audit-only field: up to 10 latest-per-ticker historical RAW Gold events. Never use this capped field for rolling-month report completeness.

scoring.candidate_rule: Sniper BUY/SELL on D0/D1/D2 only AND trade_setup must still be ACTIVE; STOPPED/COMPLETED setups are excluded from fresh candidates. D0=FRESH, D1=RECENT_REVALIDATE, D2=AGING_REVALIDATE.
scoring.actionability_rule: D1/D2 remain discovery-eligible only while ACTIVE; current displacement from original entry, remaining distance to TP1, invalidation distance and remaining R:R to TP1 are exported for report-time revalidation.
scoring.strong_signal_rule: score>=85 + JOAT CONFIRM @ Sniper signal + current Sniper alignment + supportive niche
scoring.niche_method: GICS sub-industry technical basket when >=3 members, else GICS sector basket; 100% price/volume technical context
